description_zh: 修改数据源下添加的日志相关说明信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem modify-data-source-log --data-source-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --data-source-instance-logs LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords --log-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDataSourceLog

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
obs: Huawei Cloud OBS.
wafApi: Tencent Cloud WAF download API. 
ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值：
obs：华为云obs。
wafApi：腾讯云waf下载api。 
ckafka： 腾讯云ckafka
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID, which is an MD5 hash generated by Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) based on specific parameters.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639736.html to obtain the data source ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639736.html获取数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The details of the data source parameters, in JSON array format
parameters.help_zh: 数据源参数详情，json数组格式
parameters.name: data_source_instance_logs

parameters.help_en: The log ID, which is an MD5 hash generated by CTDR based on specific parameters. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639707.html to obtain the log ID
parameters.help_zh: 日志ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639707.html获取日志ID
parameters.name: log_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:
qcloud: Tencent Cloud.
aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.
hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the CTDR data management center resides. Select the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: The assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Count.description_en: The number of modified logs. A value of 1 indicates success. A value less than or equal to 0 indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 修改日志的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 修改日志的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。

LogInstanceId.description_zh: 日志的ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成
